correctness.rationale: Given a common two-sided Poisson event clock, a label last reset at event j has Gaussian variance 2D times the sum of j+1 backward exponential gaps. For distinct labels the exact probability of both having last reset index j is c_N b_N^j; its limit p²q^{2j} yields age-class concentration, and the tail class fraction is bounded by q_N^{J+1}. Conditional Brownian independence establishes convergence of bounded empirical observables; uniform eighth moments extend it to collective squared displacement and convergence of its first two moments. Tonelli converts the Gaussian mixture second moment to the weighted exponential series; independence gives the q-product and cumulants. Exponential tilting at parameter between 1 and 1/q proves the exact right-tail prefactor. The packaged CHECK.py passed 7,499 independent exact/numerical consistency assertions; infinite claims are proved analytically, not by the checker.

value.rationale: A fixed positive batch fraction is the physically natural partial-correlation regime between independent and all-at-once reset dynamics. It produces a fully specified sample-dependent macroscopic stationary position density rather than merely an averaged one- or two-particle observable. The exact non-vanishing collective-energy fluctuations, all cumulants and sharp positive-tail prefactor quantify disorder-induced non-self-averaging and provide distribution-level benchmarks for simulations and inference. This is a natural complete characterization of a meaningful macroscopic observable; the extension is not a parameter renaming or a finite-table recomputation.
